page.overview:
What is Z Fighters?

The are the fighting portion of the Dragon Team.

Due to them just being a group of martial artists who group up from time to time, they have no official leader or particular positions, though on different occasions Master Roshi or Gohan have acted in leadership roles. Members will act of their own accord at times, though most if not all have some sort of sense of justice (or eventually developed one) and will make drastic decisions to defend their home. Throughout the years, the group consistently bolstered its ranks through the addition of former enemies and new heroes; they've routinely overcame seemingly insurmountable opponents and always emerged victorious against progressively more powerful foes.

The Z Fighters have alternatively been referred to as the Super Warriors, Earth's Special Forces, Golden Fighters (by Mr. Satan), TEAM "Z" or the .

During the Tournament of Power, Team Universe 7 was primarily made up of Z Fighters - with the exception of two members: Android 17 (who later became one) and Frieza.

Also known as: Z Warriors, Dragon Team.
